title: Metal wall panel at base or opening

checklist.item: A drained and vented cavity is shown behind the panel, open at the base and top, with insect screen.
checklist.why: A rainscreen that cannot drain or dry is only a cover.

checklist.item: Base flashing laps under the water barrier and kicks water out past the foundation or wall below.
checklist.why: Water in the cavity must leave above the base.

checklist.item: Sub-girts or clips are thermally broken or the continuous insulation is derated for them.
checklist.why: Continuous metal girts cancel most of the insulation.

checklist.item: Panel attachment allows thermal movement; clip and fastener spacing are referenced.
checklist.why: Fixed long panels oil-can and tear fasteners.

checklist.item: Dissimilar metals are separated and cut edges are protected.
checklist.why: Galvanic corrosion at fasteners stains and fails.

checklist.item: Base of panel clears grade or paving by the dimension shown, and the air and water barrier behind is named.
checklist.why: Splash-back and missing barrier names cause site decisions.
